question: Gurunaidu Sanapathi, who became India's first weightlifter to win a gold medal at the IWF in 2022, is from which state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Andhra Pradesh.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gurunaidu Sanapathi** is from **Andhra Pradesh.**
 
• He became India's first weightlifter to win a** gold medal** at the **IWF in 2022.**
 
• He created history by achieving this feat.
 
• Gurunaidu Sanapathi has brought **laurels to his state** and the country as a whole.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kerala** is a state in the southern part of India known for its **scenic beauty and backwaters**.

• It is also known for its famous temple cities, such as **Madurai and Thanjavur.**
 
• Tamil Nadu's traditional stick-martial art is called **silambam.**
 
 
 
• **Odisha** is a state in the eastern part of India known for its rich history and culture.
